thread:
incident-bot: Pager duty alert: service=embeddings-eu-west1 severity=high — elevated 500s and timeouts detected. Link: https://pd.example/INC-1835009999

maya (oncall): seeing 40% 500s for /v1/embeddings since ~12:34 UTC. Latency also up. I’m on it.

sam (sre): assigned. quick check — are we seeing traffic spike or a backend regression? can you grab recent nginx + envoy 5xx tails?

maya (oncall): tail attached: ````
[envoy] 2026-03-15T12:36:01Z "POST /v1/embeddings" 500 upstream_reset
[nginx] 12:36:02 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out)
````

lee (infra): I’m seeing increased connection churn to gpu-pool-3 in eu-west-1. Kernel OOMs on a few hosts, maybe memory pressure after the 05:00 model swap.

sam (sre): good catch. rolling back that model change to previous variant on the machines with errors. can we do a canary rollback to one host first?

maya (oncall): starting canary rollback on host eu3-node-12 now.

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: @sam you’re primary. Next oncall: @lee in 30m.

lee (infra): if rollback works we should update status page and signal customers. olivia, want a quick external line we can publish?

olivia (comms): I’ll draft. need clarity on scope and ETA to resolution. do we have an initial impact statement? are all customers affected?

maya (oncall): impact: ~20% of production requests in eu-west-1 hit errors; global traffic unaffected due to routing fallback to other regions. No data loss. mitigation: rollback started, watching. ETA ~15-30m for stabilization.

olivia (comms): thanks. putting together two messages: (1) status page blurb, (2) short social/tweet to reassure. dropping drafts here for sign-off.

olivia (comms): STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
````
We are investigating elevated error rates for the Embeddings API in eu-west-1. Some requests are returning 5xx; traffic is partially routing to other regions to reduce impact. Root cause under investigation. We have initiated a rollback of a recent model variant in eu-west-1 and are monitoring for recovery. No customer data loss has been identified. Updates every 15 minutes.
````

olivia (comms): TWEET DRAFT (short):
````
We’re investigating interruptions to our Embeddings API in eu-west-1. Mitigation is in progress and service routing is reducing impact. No data loss reported. Updates: status.redwood.example/embeddings
````

sam (sre): thumbs up on status page. small suggestion to avoid technical jargon in tweet: replace "service routing" with "traffic reroutes" or "traffic routing to other regions".

olivia (comms): updated: "Mitigation in progress; traffic is routing to other regions to reduce impact."

devon (legal): quick note — avoid definitive statements about "no data loss" until we confirm logs. say "no customer data loss identified so far" — safer.

olivia (comms): good call. updating both drafts now.

olivia (comms): REVISED STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
````
We are investigating elevated error rates for the Embeddings API in eu-west-1. Some requests are returning 5xx; traffic is routing to other regions to reduce impact. Root cause under investigation. We have initiated a rollback of a recent model variant in eu-west-1 and are monitoring for recovery. No customer data loss has been identified so far. Updates every 15 minutes.
````

olivia (comms): REVISED TWEET DRAFT:
````
We’re investigating interruptions to our Embeddings API in eu-west-1. Mitigation is in progress; traffic is routing to other regions to reduce impact. No customer data loss has been identified so far. Updates: status.redwood.example/embeddings
````

ana (support): heads-up — we already have two customers who opened high-priority tickets. Recommend sending a short targeted email to customers with active EU clusters and high QPS. I can pull a list.

sam (sre): rollback canary completed on eu3-node-12 and node is healthy. starting rollback on remaining nodes in that pool. metrics trending back toward normal on canary (5xx down to 3%).

maya (oncall): full rollback in progress. will update in 10m.

olivia (comms): if metrics keep improving i suggest holding social post until we confirm recovery to avoid flip-flop. but we should update status page now with the current draft. anyone object?

devon (legal): no objection. status page is fine with the wording we agreed.

lee (infra): no objection. keep social hold until green for at least 5 minutes.

olivia (comms): publishing status update now. copy pasted below for channel audit: 
````
STATUS PAGE: Published at 12:50 UTC — "Investigating elevated error rates for the Embeddings API in eu-west-1. Some requests are returning 5xx; traffic is routing to other regions to reduce impact. Root cause under investigation. We have initiated a rollback of a recent model variant in eu-west-1 and are monitoring for recovery. No customer data loss has been identified so far. Updates every 15 minutes."
````

olivia (comms): ACTION ITEM: We need a short canned customer DM for support to use on tickets. Drafting: "Hi — we’re investigating elevated errors for embeddings in eu-west-1. Mitigation is underway and traffic is being routed to reduce impact. We’ll update you as we know more; ETA for recovery approx 15-30 minutes. Sorry for the disruption."

ana (support): good. I'll queue that in Zendesk templates and send to affected customers.

sam (sre): rollback finished across pool; 5xx back down to baseline (0.5%). continuing to watch.

maya (oncall): marking incident as mitigated in PD, will keep thread open for postmortem notes.

olivia (comms): thanks everyone. holding social post; will prepare a short post-mortem-friendly tweet once root cause confirmed and postmortem reviewed.

incident-bot: Incident changed to mitigated by maya (oncall). Tags: rollback, model-variant, eu-west-1.

maya (oncall): quick follow-up TOC for postmortem: timeline, root cause (model memory growth after variant swap), rollback plan, monitoring improvements, status page cadence, customer comms timeline. assigning draft to sam and olivia.

sam (sre): will take TL;DR and technical RCA. olivia will take communications timeline.

olivia (comms): will draft public postmortem summary + suggested social copy. will share in #postmortems when ready.

ana (support): closing customer tickets with update, leaving link to status page.

lee (infra): filing infra jira to add guardrail to model swap rollout to prevent memory spike on live pool.

sam (sre): thanks team. will schedule a brief 30m post-incident sync after stabilization window to capture notes.

maya (oncall): incident thread done for now, keeping open for postmortem contributions. :thumbsup:
